avoid_when: Avoid when the opening slide needs a photograph, logo, or supporting visual.
Avoid when substantial agenda or explanatory content must appear on the first page.
families.description: A restrained formal cover uses a wide blue title band above centered presenter details and a presentation date.
families.digest: cover with title band and presenter details
families.name: cover-hero
selection_hints: Use for a formal presentation cover with a short centered title.
Choose when presenter name, affiliation, and date should be clearly identified.
Works well for corporate, interview, or internal review presentations.

avoid_when: Avoid when contact details, next steps, or a detailed recap are required.
Avoid for content-heavy conclusions or data summaries.
families.description: A minimalist closing page centers one large farewell statement on an otherwise open canvas.
families.digest: minimal closing with centered farewell message
families.name: closing-hero
selection_hints: Use as a simple final slide for a formal presentation.
Choose when the deck should end with a prominent farewell or feedback invitation.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content does not need a supporting visual.
Avoid for dense data, multi-step processes, or several parallel points.
families.description: A broad title introduces a balanced two-column explanation with a large visual on the left and descriptive text on the right.
families.digest: title with diagram and explanatory text
families.name: content-split
selection_hints: Use for explaining one concept with a large supporting visual and a paragraph.
Choose when the visual and narrative should receive roughly equal emphasis.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content cannot be structured into a sizable matrix.
Avoid when the page needs charts, imagery, or a narrative sequence instead of tabular detail.
families.description: A bold header introduces a large structured table, followed by a rounded callout highlighting the most important interpretation.
families.digest: large data table with emphasis callout
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Choose for presenting dense structured data in a wide matrix.
Use when a table needs a prominent concluding takeaway or caveat.
Works best with several columns and multiple comparable rows.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content needs charts, imagery, or multiple columns.
Avoid for highly visual storytelling or side-by-side comparisons.
families.description: A conventional text-led content page pairs a prominent blue title band with a spacious single-column bullet area.
families.digest: title band with large bullet list
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a straightforward topic explanation organized as several key points.
Choose when one bullet may need a longer supporting description.
Suitable for text-led content with a strong colored title band.

avoid_when: Avoid when the agenda needs descriptions, timings, or multiple columns.
Avoid when presenting detailed content rather than a section overview.
families.description: A blue title band introduces a spacious, single-column numbered agenda on a white field.
families.digest: simple agenda with numbered topic list
families.name: agenda-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a concise agenda of roughly four major sections.
Choose when a clean, formal table of contents is needed.
